original_evidence_search.conclusion: The historical metrics are single-value summaries only; no parseable raw iperf3 output, per-run logs, or batch manifest was recovered. They are not treated as recovered original evidence.

supplementary_replication.failed_initial_sandbox_attempt: Top-level run directories preserve ten Docker-socket-permission failures before escalated Docker execution. The primary Docker attempt contained one 100 Mbps iperf3 failure; an explicit retry was run. The additional 100 Mbps attempt made during diagnosis is also retained, but not mixed into the planned cohort.
